concerns.text: FR-004 requires **bootstrap resampling (≥ 100 iterations)**, but the task list (T021‑T028) only defines a Leave‑One‑Out Jackknife protocol. No task creates or validates a bootstrap loop, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-005 mandates calculation of stability metrics from **bootstrap** subsamples. The existing LOO‑Jackknife tasks (T021‑T028) produce stability metrics, but they do not satisfy the required bootstrap methodology, so the functional requirement is not met.
